messages:
maria gonzalez: opening follow-up thread for Seabreeze on-prem incident. short recap: peering session dropped during scheduled maintenance, control-plane timeouts, and brief tenant isolation. compiling owners + ETAs. please claim.

kevin li: i'll own the peering teardown race fix. reproduced in stress harness. planning PR by 2025-01-20 with unit + integ tests.

tanvi patel: i'll build a network-fuzz harness for onprem (jitter/asymmetric routes) and add a CI job. prototype by 2025-01-24.

phil ward: i'll add an asymmetric-route alert and dashboard tile (peering-flap delta). aiming for 2025-01-22 and will attach runbook link.

amanda chen: i'll draft a safe fallback (gateway model) config and include a post-deploy smoke (3 small requests across boundary to check KV consistency). draft ETA 2025-01-27.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SRE-8601 (Seabreeze peering followups) - https://jira.internal/SRE-8601

maria gonzalez: action tracker (paste into SRE-8601):
```
- Owner: kevin li | Action: fix peering teardown race + tests | ETA: 2025-01-20 | Ticket: SRE-8601-1
- Owner: tanvi patel | Action: onprem network fuzz harness + CI job | ETA: 2025-01-24 | Ticket: SRE-8601-2
- Owner: phil ward | Action: asymmetric-route alert + dashboard | ETA: 2025-01-22 | Ticket: SRE-8601-3
- Owner: amanda chen | Action: gateway-fallback design + smoke | ETA: 2025-01-27 | Ticket: SRE-8601-4
- Owner: jonathan park | Action: isolation triage runbook + escalation cadence | ETA: 2025-02-05 | Ticket: SRE-8601-5
```

jonathan park: also proposing a regression rule: if same isolation pattern (peering flap -> control-plane timeouts -> tenant error spike) happens twice in 90 days, auto-create a cross-team incident review and notify infra lead + security.

maria gonzalez: agree. scheduling a short retro for owners: 2025-01-29 10:00 PT. ops-bot please send invite.

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent to participants for 2025-01-29 10:00 PT.

kevin li: :thumbsup: i'll include logs and a minimal repro in the PR to speed review.

tanvi patel: i'll attach sample graphs (flap count, reconnection time, tenant error-rate, KV divergence rate) to SRE-8601.

maria gonzalez: thanks all. i'll update SRE-8601 with this thread and mark owners. call out slips in-thread so we can reassign quickly.
